verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS payroll and HR platform with a CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out controls. The robots.txt Content-Signal marker concerns crawler and AI-input policy for gusto.com, not user telemetry, so it earns no credit.
